environment.skill_extractor: SkillExtractor() from the repository CSVs; approved taxonomy additions stored in Supabase are not loaded

causes.intake_rejected: File intake: the upload checks refuse the file
causes.text_lost: File parsing / OCR: the value is not in the extracted text
causes.no_extractor: Field mapping: Kareerly has no extractor for this field
causes.section_not_detected: Section detection: the value is in the text, but its section heading is not recognised
causes.section_boundary: Section detection: an unrecognised heading lets a section run on into unrelated text
causes.false_heading: Section detection: an ordinary line is taken for a heading
causes.entity_extraction: Entity extraction: the text and section are there, but the value is wrong or missing
causes.entry_limit: Entity extraction: only one education entry is ever returned
causes.entry_split: Entity extraction: a date line or the wrapped half of a title is returned as an entry of its own
causes.date_normalization: Date normalisation: the date is in the text but the extracted year is wrong
causes.skill_alias_missing: Skill normalisation: the resume's wording is not a known alias of the skill
causes.skill_alias_present: Skill normalisation: an alias is in the text (often an unreviewed candidate alias or a generic word Kareerly filters) but the skill was not returned
causes.skill_false_positive: Skill normalisation: a skill was returned that the resume does not state
